name: Invited
descr: Invitation created and awaiting SAP identity verification

name: Identity Verified
descr: SAP identity was verified for the invitation

name: Pending Approval
descr: SAP identity is verified and awaits PM approval

name: Provision Queued
descr: Approved access is queued for provisioning

name: Provisioning
descr: External access provisioning is in progress

name: Role Changing
descr: External role change is in progress

name: Revoke Queued
descr: Access revocation is queued and local access is suspended

name: Revoking
descr: External access revocation is in progress

name: Active
descr: User access is active and reconciled

name: Suspended
descr: IDTS-local access is suspended pending an explicit reactivation.

name: Retryable Failure
descr: Provisioning failed temporarily and may be retried

name: Failed
descr: Invitation or onboarding failed before provisioning
